lines.text: CoopTracker. Cooperative finance, without the spreadsheets.
Members, collections, loans and dividends live in one place, always reconciled.
See the whole co-op at a glance, and exactly who has paid this period.
Mark collections, and track each member's shares and capital.
Follow every loan to the last peso, then share the interest pool fairly.
Dividends are computed, not guessed, and tested before they're saved.
CoopTracker. Designed and built by Keith Vergara.
